messages.subject: gmShiny v0.1.0
parts:
Hello Colleagues,

We would like to announce a minor release for the gmShiny app (v0.1.0). All changes are noted in the NEWS file on GitHub (https://github.com/geomorphR/gmShiny). Launching the app from the landing page (www.gmshiny.com) will automatically bring you to v0.1.0. 

The most impactful change made to this new version is our change-over in hosting server. Please contact us if you experience connectivity or speed issues with this new version (erica...@gmail.com).

As a final note for those using StereoMorph files with continuous curves: we are currently working out some issues regarding curve definition. Thus, we anticipate a patch release coming shortly addressing those bugs. 

Best,

Dean, Mike, Antigoni, and Erica (the geomorph team)
